VS Code — Keyboard Cheatsheet (macOS)

Source: vscode_cheatsheet.md

File & Window

Shortcut What it does
Cmd+N New file
Cmd+O Open file
Cmd+S Save
Cmd+Shift+S Save as
Cmd+W Close tab
Cmd+Shift+T Reopen closed tab
Cmd+K Cmd+W Close all tabs
Cmd+\ Split editor
Cmd+1/2/3 Focus editor group 1/2/3
Ctrl+Tab Cycle open tabs

View & Panels

Shortcut What it does
Cmd+B Toggle sidebar
Cmd+J Toggle bottom panel
Ctrl+`` Open/focus terminal
Cmd+Shift+E Explorer
Cmd+Shift+G Source control
Cmd+Shift+X Extensions
Cmd+Shift+D Run & Debug
Cmd+K Z Zen mode

Command Palette

Shortcut What it does
Cmd+Shift+P Command palette
Cmd+P Quick open file
Cmd+Shift+O Go to symbol in file
Cmd+T Go to symbol in workspace

Terminal

Shortcut What it does
Ctrl+`` New / toggle terminal
Cmd+Shift+`` New terminal instance
Cmd+K Clear terminal
Ctrl+C Interrupt running process

Editing

Shortcut What it does
Cmd+X Cut line (no selection needed)
Cmd+C Copy line (no selection needed)
Opt+↑/↓ Move line up/down
Shift+Opt+↑/↓ Duplicate line up/down
Cmd+Shift+K Delete line
Cmd+Enter Insert line below
Cmd+Shift+Enter Insert line above
Cmd+] / Cmd+[ Indent / outdent
Cmd+/ Toggle line comment
Shift+Opt+A Toggle block comment
Cmd+Z / Cmd+Shift+Z Undo / redo

Multi-cursor & Selection

Shortcut What it does
Opt+Click Add cursor
Cmd+Opt+↑/↓ Add cursor above/below
Cmd+D Select next match
Cmd+Shift+L Select all matches
Opt+Shift+drag Column (box) selection
Cmd+L Select current line
Shift+Opt+→ Expand selection
Shift+Opt+← Shrink selection

Code Intelligence

Shortcut What it does
Ctrl+Space Trigger suggestion
Cmd+. Quick fix / code action
F12 Go to definition
Opt+F12 Peek definition
Shift+F12 Find all references
F2 Rename symbol
K I (hover) Show hover info
Shift+Opt+F Format document

Navigation

Shortcut What it does
Ctrl+- Go back
Ctrl+Shift+- Go forward
Cmd+G Go to line
Cmd+Shift+\ Jump to matching bracket
Cmd+↑/↓ Jump to file top/bottom
Opt+←/→ Word left/right
Cmd+←/→ Line start/end
Fn+↑/↓ Page up/down

Search & Replace

Shortcut What it does
Cmd+F Find in file
Cmd+H Replace in file
Cmd+Shift+F Find in workspace
Cmd+Shift+H Replace in workspace
Cmd+Shift+M Problems panel
F8 / Shift+F8 Next / previous error
Opt+Enter Select all find matches

Git / Source Control

Shortcut What it does
Cmd+Shift+G Source control panel
Cmd+Enter Commit (in message box)
Opt+. Accept current change (diff)
Opt+, Accept incoming change (diff)
F7 / Shift+F7 Next / previous diff hunk
